We’re looking for a hands-on finance leader to own and build our finance function as we scale. You’ll work side by side with our founders and leadership team on strategic decisions, while still rolling up your sleeves to get the foundations right. This is for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and who wants to have a big impact on how we scale in the future.

**About Pandektes

**Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

**About The Role

**You’ll be a key strategic leader at Pandektes, shaping our current financial setup and optimising it for scale.

We’re looking for a commercially minded finance leader who thrives in high-growth environments and understands what it takes to scale a company from early traction.

You will own and evolve the finance function end-to-end; from building scalable financial infrastructure to partnering closely with our CEO and board on strategic decisions. You’ll combine sharp financial thinking with hands-on execution, ensuring we have the insights, structure, and capital needed to scale responsibly and ambitiously.

As part of the leadership team you’ll play a key role in scaling Pandektes. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both strategic finance and operational execution.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Own and evolve Pandektes’ financial strategy, ensuring our financial setup scales with our growth ambitions

• Act as a strategic sparring partner to the CEO and leadership team on company-wide decisions

• Set up and continuously improve operational finance processes, systems, and controls

• Fully own business performance metrics, in particular providing insight into key SaaS indicators to drive business performance, support strategic decision-making and identify opportunities for profitable growth

• Own company-wide budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning

• Work with external partners on accounting, audits, compliance etc.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• Significant experience in high-growth startups or scale-ups, ideally in a VC- or PE-backed environment

• Proven track record leading or playing a central role in fundraising (Series A/B/C and beyond) and/or M&A processes

• Solid understanding of operational finance, including setting up finance functions from scratch or early stage

• Deep experience in excel modelling with a proven track record of delivering automation to manual and complicated processes

• Comfort in dealing with transactional level detail where required in advance of automation and process improvement

• Proven experience with budgeting, forecasting, and P&L management

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn financial data into clear business insights

• You are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive in fast-moving environments

**How We Work

**We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We believe that ownership is what brings us the best teams – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in Copenhagen, Hamburg, London and Zurich. This role will be based in our Copenhagen HQ.

**What we offer

**

• Competitive compensation + an attractive warrant program

• A collaborative work environment where your input is not only valued but often implemented within hours

• A central office in Copenhagen, where you can work closely with an ambitious and growing team

• International team events – last time we went to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you join us next time

• 25 vacation days per year + public holidays

• Your own Pleo card for necessary work expenses

• Paid parental leave

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

**_We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

_

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager to lead complex enterprise implementations in a fast-moving company on a mission to help businesses fight financial crime and simplify compliance.

This role combines project leadership, technical problem-solving, and hands-on work with customer data. You'll get a front-row seat to how large organizations run KYC and compliance - and you'll be the one who makes it painless for them. Customer pain is our pain, and your goal is to turn their messy real-world problems into a smooth, structured onboarding experience.

You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable acting as an owner of the data workstream in onboarding and collaborating closely on integration-dependent deliveries.

You'll own implementations end-to-end for a portfolio of customers: project plans, stakeholder alignment, data mapping, validation, troubleshooting, and clear communication throughout delivery.

You'll work closely with peers in Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Support, especially when delivery depends on integrations, APIs, or data workflows.

We're open to strong mid-level and senior candidates.

After go-live, you'll stay close enough to support adoption and a smooth handover into the broader customer lifecycle.

**Example projects you might run

**

• Enterprise onboarding: Managing multiple stakeholders (Compliance, IT, business owners) against a fixed go-live date.

• Data intake and migration: Mapping customer data into Avallone templates, validating outcomes, and troubleshooting edge cases.

• Integration-dependent delivery: Aligning requirements, timelines, and technical dependencies across teams.

• Most weeks you'll have multiple onboardings or delivery workstreams running in parallel, so executing with urgency, communicating clearly, and keeping momentum is key.

**Roles + Responsibilities

**

• Act as an owner for onboarding and implementation for your customer portfolio: build project plans, coordinate stakeholders, and drive execution against timelines.

• Lead the technical workstream: handle data intake, mapping, validation, troubleshooting, and iterative improvement of datasets.

• Turn customer processes into concrete steps: capture requirements, map processes, and build clear action plans.

• Run customer-facing communication: provide status updates, manage risk, and set expectations with everyone from compliance specialists to executives.

• Drive cross-functional success: work with Product and Engineering when delivery involves integrations/APIs; surface issues early, help drive them to closure, and feed insights back into the product roadmap.

• Support post-go-live motions: conduct adoption check-ins and health checks, and contribute to QBR preparation.

• Notice early when a customer is drifting, put a plan on the table, and drive it.

• Flag when a customer is ready for more (more users, workflows, or products) and bring the context to Sales.

• Share what you learn so the team gets faster over time (checklists, templates, SOPs, playbook improvements).

**What Success Looks Like (first 6 Months)

**

• You've delivered multiple onboardings to a predictable go-live without surprises in the final stretch.

• Customers trust the output: uploads are validated, issues are documented clearly, and fixes happen fast.

• You've helped customers reach meaningful early value (Activation) and built momentum towards steady, everyday use.

• You've improved at least one repeatable artifact (template/checklist/SOP) based on patterns you've seen in real implementations.

**Requirements

**We'll hire at the level that matches your experience.

**Core Requirements

**

• Experience in Customer Success, onboarding/implementation, project management, or a similar customer-facing role in a SaaS environment.

• Strong project management skills: you can create structure, align people, and keep delivery moving.

• Technical aptitude and comfort working hands-on with customer data (not just coordinating): CSVs/templates, mapping, validation checks, troubleshooting, and attention to detail.

• Professional proficiency in both written and verbal communication in English.

• Strong ownership and follow-through.

**What tends to make people successful in this role

**

• You like turning messy, real-world problems into a clear plan and getting it done.

• You communicate early when something is off track.

• You know when "good enough to ship" is the right call, and you document what you did.

**Leveling guidance

**

• Mid-level: you can run well-scoped onboardings, execute established workflows, and escalate early when needed.

• Senior: you lead the toughest implementations, handle ambiguity, coach others through tricky technical/data cases, and drive cross-functional execution.

**Bonus points

**

• Strong proficiency in Danish is a big plus.

• API-enabled implementations and/or data integrations.

• Experience in compliance-heavy domains (KYC/AML, sanctions, risk, or similar).

• Comfortable using simple tooling to validate/troubleshoot data (e.g., basic SQL, Excel/Sheets checks, BI).

**Why Avallone?

**At Avallone, implementations matter commercially, operationally, and for customer trust. You'll work on real delivery problems with smart colleagues across Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Support.

You'll help shape how we run onboardings as we scale, and you'll join a company that values a true people-first culture. We care about our customers, our values, and each other.

We focus on your passion and desire to grow, and we believe that when we win big, we celebrate big. You'll collaborate, learn, and grow with some of the smartest people in the industry - and you will have a lot of fun doing it!

**Location

**Copenhagen, Denmark – hybrid (primarily office-based)

**How To Apply

**We hire on a rolling basis and will close the process once we've found the right person. If this sounds like you, don't wait, send us your application.

_Are you excited about working with data and business performance, and motivated to continuously improve how things are done?

_Pandora is currently looking for a Student Assistant to join our Investment Governance & Performance team within Global Network Development & Insights. In this role, you will support the governance and performance tracking of investments across Pandora's global store network. You will work closely with the Franchise & Network Management team as well as local property teams, helping ensure that investment decisions are financially sound, strategically aligned, and supported by data-driven insights.

This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience with investment analysis, retail network strategy, and business performance management in one of the world's leading jewellery brands. Working closely with stakeholders across Pandora's global organization, you will gain exposure to how strategic decisions regarding store openings, relocations, lease renewals, and closures are evaluated, approved, and measured.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Contribute to optimization and automation of investment governance processes.

• Provide analysis and insights to support and improve future network investment decisions.

• Maintain and update the global investment overview and support ongoing investment governance activities.

• Upload and track Investment Proposals (IPs) and support hindsight reporting to evaluate business case performance against actual results.

• Support ongoing store classification processes and ad hoc business requests.

**Your Team

**The Global Network Development & Insights function partners with the Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) organization to provide strategic insights that shape Pandora's global retail and franchise network. The team collaborates closely with Cluster Property Directors and commercial stakeholders worldwide to drive performance, support investment decisions, and execute global growth priorities.

You will report to the Network Expansion & Investments Senior Manager and become part of a collaborative, international team focused on data-driven decision-making and strategic investment optimization.

**Qualifications

**

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree within Business Administration, Finance, Data Analytics, IT, or a related field.

• Ideally have around two years remaining of your studies.

• Proficient in Microsoft Excel and comfortable working with large datasets.

• Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.

• Experience with Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate, AI, or other data and automation tools is considered an advantage.

• Interest in using data and technology to solve business challenges.

**Personal Competencies

**

• Analytical, curious, and motivated by solving complex business challenges.

• Structured, detail-oriented, and highly organized in your way of working.

• Proactive and able to take ownership of tasks while working independently.

• Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

• Collaborative and confident working with stakeholders across different functions and markets.

• Strong communication skills and a continuous improvement mindset.

• Eager to learn and develop both technical and commercial capabilities.

**What We Offer

**A position as a Student Assistant at Pandora offers you an opportunity for both personal and professional development in a global organization. This is your chance to join the world's largest jewellery brand and gain valuable experience within investment governance, business performance, and retail network strategy while working alongside talented and passionate colleagues.

**You Will Get

**

• Hands-on experience with investment analysis and decision-making in a global retail business.

• Exposure to senior stakeholders across Commercial, Finance, and Network Development.

• Insight into how data and business cases drive store investment and network decisions.

• Support and coaching from your manager and experienced team members.

• The opportunity to build analytical, commercial, and stakeholder management skills that will benefit your future career.

**Additional Information

**

• You are expected to work approximately 15-20 hours per week on average (less during exam periods and more when possible).

• The role is based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen and requires physical presence.

• You must be a current student to apply.

• Start date: As soon as possible.

**Did We Get Your Attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you would like to become part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site at Pandora Group.

**Icing on the Cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

At Genmab, we’re committed to building extra[not]ordinary futures together, by developing antibody products and pioneering, knock-your-socks-off therapies that change the lives of patients and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. From our people who are caring, candid, and impact-driven to our business, which is innovative and rooted in science, we believe that being proudly unique, determined to be our best, and authentic is essential to fulfilling our purpose.

**The Role and Department

**The Late Stage CMC Project organization is growing and we are looking for 2 Directors to lead and develop a team of Project Managers in Genmab’s late-stage CMC project organization.

The roles have similar responsibility and you will combine people leadership with strategic oversight and hands-on responsibility for complex CMC programs, including contribution to governance of outsourced activities with contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs).

Both postions report to the Senior Director, Head of the Late-Stage Project Management Office, within Genmab Tech Ops in Denmark. Working closely with CMC, Regulatory Affairs, Quality and Supply Chain, you will align CMC delivery with development priorities and drive progress towards regulatory submission and commercial readiness.

You will help shape the late-stage project organization, develop experienced Project Managers and translate portfolio priorities into clear decisions and reliable delivery.

**Responsibilities

**Team leadership and development

• Lead and develop your team through resource planning, recruitment, performance management and succession planning, building capabilities for current and future portfolio needs

• Coach Project Managers in strategic thinking, cross-functional leadership and resolving complex CMC challenges. Set clear expectations, delegate effectively and build accountability for results

• Work closely with the Senior Director to prioritize resources and budgets across the team’s programs, resolve capacity constraints and align delivery with portfolio objectives

CMC strategy and project responsibilities

• Shape CMC strategies with technical and functional leads, aligned with overall Drug Development Plans. Lead assigned programs through integrated planning, budget analysis and management of cross-program dependencies.

• Drive cross-functional delivery of technology transfer, process validation, manufacturing readiness and submission documentation, with clear ownership and adherence to Genmab’s quality system and applicable regulatory requirements

• Ensure reliable plans, risk and decision logs, and executive reporting. Anticipate portfolio impacts, resolve high-impact issues and facilitate data-driven options and recommendations to senior governance forums

• Lead improvements to the Project Manual, governance and ways of working, including digital and AI-enabled tools that strengthen planning, risk management and delivery

**CDMO collaboration and project governance

**

• Representing Late Stage CMC Project Management in CDMO joint project and steering committees, facilitating strategic discussions and decisions within delegated authority. Ensure decisions translate into clear commitments and follow-through

• Shape outsourcing and partnership strategies with relevant functions, aligning proposals, contracts and quality agreements with program objectives, business needs and intellectual property considerations

• Hold partners accountable for agreed scope, quality, timelines and budgets. Build transparent relationships, resolve vendor conflicts and escalate strategic trade-offs and risks with clear recommendations

**Requirements

**

• Master’s degree or higher in natural sciences, pharmacy, engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience

• Extensive biopharmaceutical CMC experience, including late-stage biologics development and progression towards commercial supply. Experience with antibody-drug conjugates is an advantage

• Proven experience shaping strategies and leading complex global CMC programs, including portfolio prioritization, strategic budget management and cross-functional risk resolution

• Established people-leadership experience, with a track record of developing Project Managers, building team capabilities and supporting talent and succession planning

• Strong understanding of technology transfer, process validation, submission strategies and the interdependencies between development, manufacturing and supply

• Experience shaping outsourcing strategies, leading CDMO governance and resolving complex partner issues with sound business judgment

• Advanced knowledge of GMP and global CMC regulatory expectations, including those relevant to FDA, EMA and NMPA submissions

• Excellent English communication skills, with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and translating complex issues into clear business recommendations.

**About You

**You combine strategic perspective with the judgment to know when to engage directly and when to empower others. You develop people, set clear priorities and make well-founded decisions under uncertainty, balancing quality, timelines and cost.

You build trust across functions and cultures, challenge assumptions constructively and create an inclusive environment where colleagues take ownership. You champion a ONE-Team approach, welcome feedback and turn lessons learned into improvements across the project organization.

**Location and Travel

**The role is based in Denmark. Travel is expected to be approximately 10–15 days per year.

Genmab leverages the effectiveness of an agile working environment, when possible, for the betterment of employee work-life balance. Our offices are designed as open, community-based spaces that work to connect our employees. Whether you’re in one of our collaboratively designed office spaces or working remotely, we thrive on connecting with each other to innovate.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK883.200,00---1.324.800,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

OBJECTIVES OF THE PROGRAMME

The European Region (EURO) of WHO is made of 53 countries, with over 880 million people. The diversity of people and health situations requires a solid understanding of the emerging socio-economic, epidemiologic, and demographic patterns and trends at regional, national and sub-national levels, with due sensitivity to disadvantaged populations and vulnerable segments of the society. It is equally crucial to have a solid understanding of the commonalities and divergences of the health systems, the circumstances and political economy under which they have evolved and operate. The Division of Programme Management ensures the technical excellence of WHO/Europe's work. It coordinates and ensures coherence across WHO/Europe's health programmes, country support and the Special Initiative on Primary Health Care (PHC).The division also leads planning and budgeting, resource mobilization and partnerships, communications and publications, governance and external relations and language services.

**Description Of Duties

**Under the direct supervision of the Director Programme Management and in close collaboration with the Director Business Operations and the Technical Directors, the incumbent:

• 
Leads the Regional Office's work in the areas of external relations, communications and publications, language services, and governing bodies.

• 
Provides high level strategic support through provision of policy, managerial and diplomatic advice to senior management.

• 
Promotes a culture of high performance, team work, ethical behaviour and integrity in accordance with the Organization's policies, rules and procedures.

• 
Provides support to the DPM in monitoring the implementation of the Global Policy Group of WHO (GPG) decisions and the strategic directions of WHO's work in the Region;

• 
Builds partnerships and contributes to effective and efficient three level coordination in the areas of responsibility, ensuring that countries benefit from the best possible support and advice from WHO headquarters, Regional Office and country office resources.

• 
Oversees and ensures rapid and clear information flows with other regions and WHO headquarters in areas of responsibility.

• 
Contributes to WHO regional coordination and serves as a member of EURO's Executive Council.

• 
Coordinates the work of the technical secretariat for WHO governing body meetings (World Health Assembly, WHO Executive Board, Regional Committee and the Standing Committee of the Regional Committee) and other senior management and advisory meetings.

• 
Interacts with technical directors to ensure implementation of policy decisions of WHO governing bodies

• 
Performs any other duties assigned by the 1st and/or 2nd level supervisor.

**Required Qualifications

**Education

Essential: Advanced university degree in public health, international relations, communications, social sciences or business management.

Desirable: Training in public health related issues.

**Experience

**Essential: At least 15 years of national and international experience with some years at the international level in a senior management position including experience in developing countries. Extensive writing and communications experience. Experience in multipartner health programme management and leadership. Experience guiding and interpreting WHO rules and procedures, including close familiarity with the work of the Regional Office and WHO governing bodies.

Desirable: Experience in the political and/or diplomatic arena.

**Skills

**

• 
Ability to exercise leadership and to work effectively with colleagues at national and international levels;

• 
Diplomatic skills;

• 
Ability to negotiate and engage in new partnerships;

• 
Ability to coordinate teams with different backgrounds in a multicultural environment;

• 
Excellent writing skills in English in a variety of styles and under tight deadline pressure;

• 
Ability to develop messaging and positioning for an international organization;

• 
Demonstrated networking skills, excellent interpersonal skills;

• 
Thorough understanding of public health and international development issues, with the ability to quickly understand, process and communicate new information;

• 
Proven ability to plan, execute, collaborate and work independently with donors, partners, etc.

**WHO Competencies

**

• 
Teamwork*

• 
Respecting and promoting individual and cultural differences*

• 
Communication*

• 
Producing results

• 
Moving forward in a changing environment

• 
Creating an empowering and motivating environment*

Use of Language Skills

Essential: Expert knowledge of English.

Desirable: Intermediate knowledge of French, German and/or Russian.

WHO salaries for staff in the Professional category are calculated in US dollars. The remuneration for the above position comprises an annual base salary starting at USD 117,953 (subject to mandatory deductions for pension contributions and health insurance, as applicable), a variable post adjustment, which reflects the cost of living in a particular duty station, and currently amounts to USD 6871 per month for the duty station indicated above. Other benefits include 30 days of annual leave, allowances for dependent family members, home leave, and an education grant for dependent children.

**

Staff members separated due to the 2025 Prioritization and Realignment Process will receive special consideration according to the applicable regulatory framework.

• 
This vacancy notice may be used to fill other similar positions at the same grade level.

• 
Only candidates under serious consideration will be contacted.

The list can be accessed through the link: http://www.whed.net/. Some professional certificates may not appear in the WHED and will require individual review.

**The Impact You'll Make

**Join Danfoss Power Solutions as our new Controller, Procurement Controlling!

Being part of our Finance division, you will help shape how procurement performance is measured, understood, and improved across Danfoss Power Solutions. Your work will provide the insights that procurement leaders use to make decisions, track savings, and connect procurement activities with business results. Working in a truly global environment, you will collaborate with stakeholders from operational teams through to senior leadership, turning large and complex datasets into clear recommendations and meaningful actions.

This role offers a unique combination of analytics, business partnering, and exposure to strategic growth initiatives, including integration and transformation projects across the organization. You can be based at one of our Danfoss Power Solutions locations in Europe, the US or Mexico.

**What You’ll Be Doing

Are you experienced in managing CMO collaborations and building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders? Do you thrive in a broad QA role where you combine your GMP expertise with a pragmatic and hands-on approach across different quality areas?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new QA Specialist in QA Commercial Operations.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate QA specialist to join our team. You will be a part of the well-functioning QA Drug Substance/QA for QC team in the QA Commercial Operations department, with responsibility for quality oversight of starting materials, intermediates, and Drug Substances for commercial products. We have a close collaboration with our Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) and process- and QC SMEs internally at Ascendis Pharma.

Your key responsibilities will be:

As part of the role, you will work broadly across quality oversight activities and take ownership of a wide range of tasks and responsibilities, including:

• Take primary responsibility for oversight of one or more CMOs in our supply chains with respect to review and approval of documentation from these CMOs, including upscale activities, PPQ documentation, CPVs, batch documentation, deviations, changes, CAPAs, stability studies, QMRs, quality agreements etc

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key CMO stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and effective collaboration through meetings, teleconferences, and audits. Participate in CMO evaluations and product quality reviews

• Keep up to date with changes in relevant product guidelines and regulatory requirements and ensure cGMP at Ascendis and CMOs

• Drive and assume responsibility for agreed tasks and matters

• Continuously optimize our work processes and the way we execute quality oversight

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a relevant academic degree - preferably a master's degree in pharmacy or equivalent - and 5-10 years of experience within chemical and/or biological GMP production

Furthermore, you have:

• 
Solid QA experience, preferably including QA for QC, and experience working with CMOs

• 
Strong analytical skills, a collaborative mindset, and a can-do attitude

• 
Cultural understanding

• 
Experience with audits/inspections

• 
A critical and  pragmatic mindset and yet with attention to the necessary details

• 
Clear and persistent communication skills, particular regarding expectations and requirements to quality

• 
Cooperative and striving for smooth cooperation with many stakeholders

• 
Ambitious and able to see the benefits in going the extra mile

The position as QA specialist requires experience with and knowledge of US and EU GMP regulations and requirements. Furthermore, you should be proficient in English at a professional level, both written and spoken, and you master MS Office.

At Ascendis Pharma, you will be part of a stimulating, informal, and innovative working environment, where you will interact with very skilled colleagues and partners to deliver on Ascendis' ambitious corporate goals. You will be part of an expanding QA-organization overseeing development, clinical, and commercial activities.

Travel: 5-20 days/year.

Place of work: Tuborg Boulevard 12, Hellerup

**Your impact begins here

**As Sr Manager, LIMS and Ecosystems, you will lead the team responsible for LIMS (Laboratory IT Management Systems) and Ecosystems, giving people clear direction and turning departmental plans into priorities they can act on today. You will build a team that is well staffed, growing and accountable, and work with IT and business partners to secure reliable, compliant delivery. Your impact will be felt in a team that performs consistently and in the colleagues who rely on its work.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are a people leader who sets direction, follows through and keeps teams moving, in a complex and regulated environment.

• A Master’s degree or equivalent relevant education. Substantial relevant experience may compensate for formal education requirements.

• Relevant people-leadership experience, including goal setting, delegation, performance management, development and employee relations.

• Experience leading professional employees and coordinating assignments of medium to high complexity.

• Experience translating departmental plans into operational goals, priorities and follow-up.

• Experience with workforce and capacity planning, recruitment and FTE-related budget management.

• Experience working with IT and business stakeholders in a complex, regulated organisation.

• The ability to communicate clearly, make timely decisions, work independently and handle conflicts and difficult conversations constructively.

• An inclusive mindset that respects different perspectives and reflects The Novo Way.

• Novo leadership training, or willingness to complete the required leadership training.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**Knowledge of laboratory systems, enterprise IT or adjacent regulated-business domains.

**What You’ll Do

**You will be the first-line leader for the LIMS and Ecosystems area, accountable for how the team performs, develops and delivers.

• Set clear expectations and goals for the team and each employee, and hold regular one-to-ones, team meetings and performance dialogues.

• Turn LAPS priorities into team plans, milestones and follow-up routines, balancing planned work, operational support and emerging issues based on business impact, risk and capacity.

• Act as hiring manager, plan the team’s future skills and capacity, and ensure structured onboarding, development plans, succession and career conversations.

• Own the team’s FTE-related budget and the system budgets for the area, and recommend adjustments when demand and capacity are not balanced.

• Make sure procedures, quality requirements and information security expectations are understood and followed, and that risks and compliance concerns are raised and acted on early.

• Simplify team routines, roles and interfaces, and lead agreed changes until they are embedded.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join Enterprise IT & Quality, where colleagues work across the Novo value chain, stay close to stakeholders and help deliver trusted technology, high quality and responsible ways of working. This is the department of Laboratory and PAT solutions, where colleagues deliver IT solutions and drive digitalization for laboratories and quality control across Novo globally.

You will lead a team of professional employees in LIMS and Ecosystems and take part in the LAPS Leadership Team, aligning priorities, capacity and dependencies with your peer leaders. Day to day, you will work with Product Management, system and solution roles, business representatives and colleagues in EIT (Enterprise IT) and Line of Business to set expectations, share delivery status and resolve issues. HR and finance partners will support you on recruitment, performance, reward, workforce planning and budget.

You will be the first escalation point for team matters, and you will make sure decisions, risks and escalations reach the right level quickly and clearly.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will be trusted to work independently within agreed objectives and to make decisions for your team. Clear performance expectations, honest feedback and a culture that recognises results will help you perform at your best, and you will have the chance to grow your own leadership through Novo’s leadership training.

You will help build an inclusive team environment based on trust, accountability, respectful dialogue and attention to well-being, and you will bring your perspective to department planning and improvement.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead a team that delivers reliable, compliant LIMS and Ecosystems services, apply by 16 November 2026.
